name: contact-list
description: List contacts, optionally filtered by role or status, with optional result limit and offset for pagination.

inputs.role: string? (filter by job title / professional role, e.g. 'CEO', 'CFO', 'Engineer'; mutually exclusive with status, limit, and offset; this is NOT a lifecycle status)
inputs.offset: number? (skip this many contacts; use with limit for cursor-based pagination)
